question: The owner's third addition, in his words: "What if we need to statistically hit a 'copier' like DNA and primordial soup?" As read: with nothing built or picked, starts taken from the record's census of connected starts of three to five knots, each of 84 laws with its knot law read on its own, and every take sampled under a stated weighting, how often does a growth make a pattern that leaves two of what it meets, more often than the law leaves two with the second pattern barred, than the second pattern leaves of its own, and than with the two patterns fully masked from each other?
inputs: The census starts in their registered order, the laws, the weightings of takes, the seeds, the pair rule, the cases and controls named in the pre-registration and its two data files; ticket C's definitions and claim; the frozen definitions of tickets A and B; the definitions of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001 and the shared definitions of RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001; the engine of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001A, unchanged, and ticket A's engine for the readings the tickets share.
forbidden_inputs: Any definition changed after a value is seen; for the engine's author, the drafter's scratch prototype and anything it produced beyond what the pre-registration and its data files disclose; any change to the frozen engines or to the frozen texts of tickets A and B; any rule added so that something is copied; any start, history or case picked after its outcome is seen.
primary_observable: For every sampled growth: its pairs of a made pattern and a part wholly apart from it that the growth makes one part, with their forms; every case of a claimed reading (form, from both, values with both from the first pattern) and of the reported readings; for every case, the rates of the reading in continuations with nothing barred, with the second pattern barred and with the first barred at 100, and for a case that passes at 100 the same at 1,000 fresh continuations with the fully masked kind added, with the case's way; the rates of sampled growths holding a confirmed case, each law separately, with zero bounds by stratum; the knot test of every knot at the last round read and, on small starts, at every round.
comparators_or_controls: The second pattern barred; the first pattern barred (the second pattern's own); the two patterns masked from joining and fully masked from joining and from taking; the machinery control; one planted case in three arms, placed by hand and counted toward nothing; ticket A's made designs and a registered sample of the scratch cases as negative controls; the holder weighting of takes on a reduced sample; renamed starts by sample and an exact check of the renaming lemma on small starts.
resource_budget: Each main run sized from measured costs to finish within about 50 minutes on 6 processes, each process under a memory cap, about three and a half hours in all, run in the registered order so that a study stopped early leaves registered prefixes; each run registered in the long-running index. Bounds: 8 rounds, at most 500 knots a growth, with the guard of the frozen engine. Conditional runs only if a case of a claimed reading is confirmed.
first_executable_signal: The gate (the census list, the samplers, the pair rule, the seeds and the replay of the scratch cases) and the controls: the machinery control and the first arm of the planted case must pass and be confirmed, and the other two arms and the negative controls must not.
decision_rule: Each prediction is judged by its 'Fails when' entry; checks of the code, replications of the scratch runs, arguments and reported readings are marked as such. A case is confirmed only when its rate with nothing barred is above each of the three controls by the registered exact test at the registered family-wise level.
stop_rule: Stop when every main run is done in its registered order, every case passing at 100 has been read at confirmation, and every prediction has a verdict; the conditional runs follow only a confirmed case of a claimed reading, and otherwise the registered 'not run' sentence goes into the result.
nonclaims: An exploratory study by sampling: about 160,000 growths of 8 rounds from starts of at most five knots, under one release rule and two taking rules. A zero is a bound on a rate under a named weighting, each law separately, for cases that pass the registered test; it does not show that no copier can arise by chance. No positive control made by the growth exists, so the test's sight rests on a planted case. Every pattern that meets is descended from one supplied start; the reading in which separate starts are joined is left to a later ticket. DNA and a primordial soup are the owner's pictures. No claim about living things, minds, physics or time.
